messages:
maria: quick heads-up — planning a frontend deploy for console: v2.7.3-rc4 in ~30m (18:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2487. Main risk: stale css/js chunks serving from CDN (fingerprint mismatch) and a small hydration fix we pushed in #2487. plan: canary 10% for 10m -> if green, promote to 100% and invalidate CDN. need 1-2 people for smoke + someone to trigger/confirm CDN purge. also want source maps uploaded before final promote. @sre-oncall FYI for edge watch.

jonathan: I'm around, can monitor frontend logs & perf during canary.

alexa: I'll take smoke — will run login, org-switch, search, dashboard charts flows. ping me when canary starts.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: canary start requested by maria — service=console-frontend build=sha256:abc123 canary=10% (started)

maria: quick note on CDN — we'll do both Fastly purge_all and a CloudFront invalidation for /assets/* after we promote. Fastly command I use locally:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.fastly.com/service/FASTLY_SERVICE_ID/purge_all" \
  -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY"
```

and CloudFront via aws cli (placeholder):

```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2XYZ --paths "/assets/*"
```

(no secrets in channel, I'll run these from my terminal)

ryan: I'll make sure source maps are pushed to Sentry before promote. queued upload now.

alexa: smoke @ 10%: login ✅, org switch ✅, search returns results but first request a bit slow (cold cache) — no console errors observed. charts render, small layout shift on initial load but not blocking.

jonathan: metrics quick check: bundle request p95 ~120ms from canary edge, no increased 5xx. logs are clean so far.

maria: thanks. proceeding to promote to 100% in 2m unless anyone sees blockers.

sre-oncall: watching edge logs and alerting on 5xx spike > 0.5% or cpu/latency anomalies. webhook to #incidents active.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: rollout progress -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%; build=sha256:abc123 (complete)

maria: promoted to 100%. Fastly purge_all returned 200. Creating CloudFront invalidation now. note: invalidation may take ~2-5m to propagate to all edges — run hard refresh if you see stale assets.

alexa: post-purge quick checks: hard refresh loads new assets ✅, charts layout fixed. search still fine. no client-side errors.

ryan: Sentry: no new regressions tied to v2.7.3-rc4; only a couple old-client 400s unrelated. tagging release in Sentry.

maria: awesome — will add release note and pin tag to repo. rollback instructions if needed: run ./deploy/rollback.sh console v2.7.2 (this will redeploy previous tag and re-trigger CDN invalidation).

jonathan: :thumbsup:

maria: big thanks — marking release done in the release spreadsheet and closing PR after smoke. feel free to reopen thread if anything pops up.
